result.topic_en: Euler expands in series the formula for the height v due to the outflow velocity of water through a tube with friction, and simplifies it for the case of a shallow upper vessel and a long narrow tube.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 355
ob cos. $\zeta = 1$, et $\mathfrak{g} = \frac{k^4}{g^4}$, erit celeritas, qua aqua per orificium CC effluet debita altitudini $v$, vt sit
$$v = \frac{A\mathfrak{B}f + Bg - l(1 - \mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{B})}{1 - \alpha B\mathfrak{g}}$$
46. Quodsi ergo valoribus proxime veris vti velimus, habebimus:
$$v\left(1 - \frac{\alpha b k^4}{g^5}\left(1 - \frac{\alpha b}{2g} + \frac{\alpha^2 b^2}{6g^2} - \frac{\alpha^3 b^3}{24 g^3} + \text{etc.}\right)\right) =$$
$$a + b - \alpha a\left(\frac{a}{2f} + \frac{b}{g}\right) + \alpha^2 a\left(\frac{aa}{6ff} + \frac{ab}{2fg} + \frac{bb}{2gg}\right) - \alpha^3 a\left(\frac{a^3}{24f^3} + \frac{a^2 b}{6ffg} + \frac{ab^2}{4fgg} + \frac{b^3}{6g^3}\right)\text{etc.}$$
$$-\frac{\alpha bb}{2g} + \frac{\alpha\alpha b^3}{6gg} - \frac{\alpha^3 b^4}{24 g^4} + \text{etc.}$$
$$-\alpha l\left(\frac{a}{f} + \frac{b}{g}\right) + \tfrac{1}{2}\alpha^2\left(\frac{a}{f} + \frac{b}{g}\right)^2 - \tfrac{1}{6}\alpha^3 l\left(\frac{a}{f} + \frac{b}{g}\right)^3 + \text{etc.}$$
quae reducitur ad hanc formam:
$$v\left(1 - \frac{k^4}{g^4}\left(\frac{\alpha b}{g} - \frac{\alpha^2 b^2}{2g^2} + \frac{\alpha^3 b^3}{6g^3} - \text{etc.}\right)\right) =$$
$$a + b - \alpha\left(\frac{aa}{2f} + \frac{ab}{g} + \frac{bb}{2g} + \frac{al}{f} + \frac{bl}{g}\right)$$
$$+ \alpha\alpha\left(\frac{a^3}{6ff} + \frac{aab}{2fg} + \frac{abb}{2gg} + \frac{b^3}{6gg} + \tfrac{1}{2}l\left(\frac{a}{f} + \frac{b}{g}\right)^2\right)$$
$$- \alpha^3\left(\frac{a^4}{24f^3} + \frac{a^3 b}{6ffg} + \frac{aabb}{4fgg} + \frac{ab^3}{6g^3} + \frac{b^4}{24g^3} + \tfrac{1}{6}l\left(\frac{a}{f} + \frac{b}{g}\right)^3\right)$$
etc.
47. Si altitudo vasis supremi $AB = a$ fuerit valde exigua, amplitudo autem $ff$ multo maior quam amplitudo tubi $gg$, simulque longitudo huius tubi $BC = b$ satis sit ingens, patet fractionem $\frac{b}{g}$ maxime superare fractionem $\frac{a}{f}$; hac igitur prae illa neglecta, erit
$$v\left(1 - \frac{k^4}{g^4}\left(\frac{\alpha b}{g} - \frac{\alpha^2 b^2}{2gg} + \frac{\alpha^3 b^3}{6g^3} - \text{etc.}\right)\right) =$$
$$a + b - \frac{\alpha b}{g}\left(a + \tfrac{1}{2}b + l\right) + \frac{\alpha\alpha bb}{gg}\left(\tfrac{1}{2}a + \tfrac{1}{6}b + \tfrac{1}{2}l\right)$$
$$- \frac{\alpha^3 b^3}{g^3}\left(\tfrac{1}{6}a + \tfrac{1}{24}b + \tfrac{1}{6}l\right)\text{ etc.}$$
atque haec series eo magis conuergit, quo minor fuerit fractio $\frac{\alpha b}{g}$.
Yy 2 \quad 48. Quan-

items.english: It is evident that the fraction b/g greatly exceeds the fraction a/f.

items.quote: atque haec series eo magis conuergit, quo minor fuerit fractio $\frac{\alpha b}{g}$.
items.english: And this series converges the more, the smaller the fraction αb/g is.
